title: Origin story: Oathkeeper Sigrid
description: Sigrid was a sword-oath sworn to a dying king: protect the heir, whatever the cost. She kept it through war, betrayal, and exile, and when the heir was crowned, the oath should have ended — but Sigrid had become the oath. She keeps vows now for those too weak to keep their own.

title: Ability profile: Oathkeeper Sigrid
description: Ranked abilities: Oath-keeping — rank 100/100; Loyalty — rank 100/100; Protection — rank 98/100; Swordsmanship — rank 97/100; Endurance — rank 96/100.

title: Power ranking: Oathkeeper Sigrid
description: Powers: Her blade defends the vow-bound; She lends strength to kept promises; Oaths sworn to her cannot be broken.

title: Stamina feats: Oathkeeper Sigrid
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Kept one oath for twenty years; Fights for others' vows without rest.
